newsitem.title: TUNISIA: CHEMICAL FIRM, BANK DRIVE TUNIS BOURSE INDEX UP.
newsitem.headline: CHEMICAL FIRM, BANK DRIVE TUNIS BOURSE INDEX UP.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Wednesday closed slightly up by 0.23 percent in trade lifted by chemical firm Al Kimia and BIAT bank, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 558.77 from 557.48 on Tuesday.
Trade volume was 1.04 million dinars against 1.14 million dinars.
Al Kimia won 2.9 dinars to 42.9 dinars.
BIAT bank was up 2 dinars to 35 dinars. ($=one dinar)
